tags.feature: - Becoming members of the new economic union could include leftist countries such as: Myanmar, Laos, Cambodia, South Yemen, Libya, Sri Lanka;

- Sri Lanka, Myanmar and Laos will require additional subsidies upon membership in economic blocs allocated for their development;

notes.title: Big update 1.9.0.

tags.feature: - more than 20 new endings that will more strongly personalise your eventual outcome of the changes in the Yugoslav republics;
- new investors in the socialist countries from other countries have been found;

- a new path for the Union of Reformist Forces of Yugoslavia, which could become a new unifying 
force in the Yugoslav space;
- more projects for the future territorial organisation of Yugoslavia were added;
- with the help of leading Yugoslav engineers, each Yugoslav region now has its own unique buildings with its own effects;
- Yugoslav and national ministers were given a preventive talk at the UDBA, after which they could change the vector of their work;
- some ministers also found time to visit the photographer and received updated portraits close to game time;
- Ibrahim Rugova was released from the MIA department, resulting in significantly increased interaction with the insurgency;
- Albanian irredentists have also been released from prison;
- Milosevic would no longer simply put up with his second role in the party and his special conditions;
- Vojvodina is no longer a "silent province";

- The XIV Congress is now held continuously, and republican delegations are voting for individual motions with greater reluctance. The results of your votes will also lie in the draft of the new Yugoslav constitution. Or not;
- the position of the PDD among the Bosnian opposition may now become more precarious;
- the Balkan commonwealth may now evolve into something more, depending on the actions of the SFRY;
- USSR 2.0 has been resolved;
- reliable communications have been established at army headquarters so that generals are not harassed by endless calls about attacks;
- more licences for independent media have been issued, which may have caused public reaction in the modifiers to change;
- the opposition radio is also no longer jammed and republican cassettes now have more than communist music;

tags.bug: - many new bugs have been added to replace the old ones;

tags.feature: - as well as a large number of achievements of varying degrees of difficulty;

tags.balance_change: - The event results on Hungary's threats have been redone.

notes.title: Ostalgie: Fall of the Curtain (DLC)
notes.content:
It happened! The Fall of the Curtain add-on is available for purchase!

The iron curtain fell. The era of change has come in Eastern Europe, but does everyone need these changes? The Cold War is coming to an end, and the "cradles of revolution" are fighting for their existence in the system of the new world order. But can they stay afloat, while retaining all the achievements and ideals of the revolution?

[list]
[*] Lead a better Korea and put an end to many years of confrontation with the South.
[*] Fidel Castro is waiting for your help, because Cuba has remained an orphan in this cruel world surrounded by enemies.
[*] Take the reins of socialist Afghanistan, once and for all done away with the Civil War.
[/list]
This DLC includes:
[list]
[*] Three playable countries: North Korea, Cuba, Afghanistan. 
[*] Lots of new and changed endings. 
[*] New mechanics of interaction between countries.
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034970/Ostalgie_Fall_of_the_Curtain/]Store Page[/url]
